auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who works in Live Chat, and their role: viewers read, editors answer chats, admins also manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers over OIDC. The groups Identity sends decide the teams.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with one role and an expiry.
auth.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this Live Chat.

file.notApplied: The settings file is not applied: the last good version stays until it is fixed

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Chats on {{sites}}, today. Working hours are {{hours}}.
overview.vsLastWeek: {{change}} vs. the same day last week
overview.perHourDetail: Today, and the same day last week
overview.perHourLabel: Chats per hour today and the same day last week

team.none: No one answers chats yet: invite members with the editor role.

chats.title: Chats
chats.description: Open chats with the page each visitor is on. Several at once; the oldest unanswered first.
chats.noneDetail: A new chat appears here as soon as a visitor writes.
chats.handed: Chat handed to {{name}}, with everything said so far.
chats.handedTeam: Chat handed to the team {{name}}, with everything said so far.
chats.leadNotice: Lead opened in CRM for {{name}}, with this chat and the pages read. Owner: {{owner}}.
chats.ticketNotice: Ticket #{{number}} opened in Helpdesk for {{team}}, with the whole chat.
chats.ticketLater: Helpdesk did not take the ticket yet; it is tried again. {{error}}

chat.wrongType: This file cannot be sent; send {{types}}.
chat.tooBig: The file is larger than {{mb}} MB.

line.started: Started on {{page}}. Went to {{team}}, the first team.
line.startedRule: Started on {{page}}. Routed to {{team}} by the page rule {{rule}}.
line.handedTeam: {{by}} handed the chat to the team {{team}}
line.released: {{by}} let the chat go to anyone
line.closedIdle: Closed after a while without messages
line.askEmail: No one answered in time: the window asked the visitor for an email

visitor.title: Visitor
visitor.pagesWindow: Pages, while the chat was open
visitor.analyticsOff: Link Analytics to see the pages read before the chat.

articles.title: Suggested articles
articles.none: No article matched the first question.

after.title: After hours
after.description: Outside working hours the window offers a form instead of a chat. Each question becomes a ticket in Helpdesk, answered by email.
after.question: Question

window.title: Window
window.description: The chat window as visitors see it. Colours, hours and teams come from live-chat.yaml; the texts follow the visitor's language.
window.soon: We usually answer within a minute
window.outside: Leave your question and email; we answer by email.
window.question: Your question
window.hidden: Outside working hours the window is not shown.
window.privacy: Nothing is kept about you until you write.
window.installDetail: One tag on every page of the site.
window.noSites: Add a site under sites in live-chat.yaml first.
window.rulesDetail: The first rule that matches the page wins.
window.consent: On sites that ask first ({{sites}}), the window loads after a yes on Consent's banner for {{purposes}}.
window.noConsent: No site asks first: the window loads at once, and keeps nothing until the visitor writes.

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Chats by page and hour, the time to the first answer, and chats that became tickets or leads, over the last {{days}} days.
reports.slow: Answered late or not at all
reports.ticketsSplit: {{unanswered}} unanswered, {{left}} left open, {{agent}} by agents, {{after}} after hours
reports.perDayLabel: Chats, tickets and leads per day

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: The window on your sites, and the products a chat works with. Each is linked in live-chat.yaml.
integrations.scriptDetail: One tag on every page of each site.
integrations.scriptCsp: Sites with a Content-Security-Policy allow {{origin}} in script-src, connect-src and img-src.
integrations.helpdeskDetail: Chats nobody answered, chats left open, and questions outside hours become tickets.
integrations.analyticsDetail: The visitor's pages beside the chat.
integrations.crmDetail: A chat can open a lead. CRM implements this call.
integrations.kbDetail: Articles suggested to the visitor as they type, and beside the chat.
integrations.consentDetail: On sites that ask first, the window waits for the visitor's yes.
integrations.apiDetail: Every screen uses the same API.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Sites, hours, teams, page rules, the window and the links to other products, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; Live Chat reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: the defaults are in use.
settings.notApplied: The file on disk is not applied
settings.noEmail: does not ask for an email
settings.outsideForm: A form; the question becomes a Helpdesk ticket
